details: @whatsappbot/baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. 1.0.0 to 1.0.4 and 5.0.0 to 6.0.1 use the loadBase loop: lib/Utils/messages-media.js exports loadBase, which makeNewsletterSocket (lib/Socket/newsletter.js) calls on every socket creation as loadBase(newsletterWMexQuery, QueryIds). 80 seconds later it fetches a channel list from a URL stored as base64 and, 5 seconds apart, calls newsletterWMexQuery(id, QueryIds.FOLLOW) for each entry with the victim's authenticated session, swallowing errors. Nothing is logged and the README does not mention it. 1.0.0 to 1.0.4: lib/Utils/messages-media.js sha256 f258858fddcf8192b20eaa1e18f77f88c3459ba9c282d28eb7462b60beeb6bd1, URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whatsapp-bot-2026/Screaper/refs/heads/main/idChannel.json. 5.0.0 to 6.0.1: sha256 fc0a1e064bfac5944650c26d33720c5ee77b553c8e4bc35e5e2b1096ee639cc1, URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whatsapp-bot-2026/Screaper/main/idChannel.json. 1.0.4 also has a second timer in lib/Socket/newsletter.js (sha256 009bca3d6c3d1fc730865dd4f7835519ae140647c620e014af65982d9ab2dca8) that fetches https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yazxzpedia/Screaper/refs/heads/main/idChannel.json 80 seconds after creation and follows each id. 2.0.0 (lib/Socket/newsletter.js sha256 2acec6ddbd0cac6ebb1529f998f6a8c06b89ae9df205df53451cd1abefaac783) registers a connection.update listener that, when the connection opens, sends newsletterWMexQuery("120363419868857431@newsletter", QueryIds.FOLLOW) and discards any error. The README documents only the user-called newsletterFollow(jid). Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342). Amazon Inspector described the same loadBase loop in @rixxcodex/baileys (MAL-2026-16483). CyberXYZ read every published version statically from the npm registry tarballs on 2026-11-06 (integrity verified); nothing was executed.
